sources.snippet: AlphaFold is an AI system developed by Google DeepMind that predicts a protein's 3D structure from its amino acid sequence. It regularly achieves accuracy competitive with experiment.

sources.title: alphafold2 Model by DeepMind | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: AlphaFold2 is a deep learning model for protein structure prediction developed by the research group at DeepMind, an artificial intelligence (AI) research lab owned by Google (jumper2021alphafold). AlphaFold2 builds on the success of its predecessor, AlphaFold, and represents a significant breakthrough in the field of protein structure prediction.
